title: condedge
intro: Find the hydraulic conductivity between two cells.

sections.name: arithmetic
sections.desc: Use the arithmetic average of the conductivity in the two cells.
sections.text:
Use the arithmetic average of the conductivity in the two cells.
   Used by uzrect Mollerup K average (see 99.1, page 539) .

sections.name: harmonic
sections.desc:
Use harmonic average of the conductivity of the two cells. This corresponds to using
the average hydraulic resistence.
sections.text:
Use harmonic average of the conductivity of the two cells. This corresponds to using
the average hydraulic resistence.

sections.name: pressure
sections.desc:
Pressure dependent average of the two cells. Use harmonic average of the conductiv-
ity of unsaturated cells. This corresponds to using the average hydraulic resistence.
For saturated cells, water may stream into unsaturated neigbor cells with saturated
conductivity if ’allow sideways’ is true. For cells where pressure is above ’h lim’,
water may stream downward to dryer cell with a conductivity corresponding to
’h lim’.
sections.sig:
< pressure (allow sideways true)
                   (use h old true)
                   (h lim h lim ) >

attrs.name: allow sideways
attrs.doc:
Allow water to flow fast from saturated cells to all neigbor cells. Not just the
     cell below.

attrs.name: use h old
attrs.doc:
Use pressure at the start of the small timestep for enabling fast flow. If false,
     use the pressure at end of the small timestep.

attrs.name: h lim
attrs.doc: Lower pressure limit for fast downward flow.

sections.text:

   < pressure (allow sideways true)
                   (use h old true)
                   (h lim h lim ) >

    allow sideways: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default true)
     Allow water to flow fast from saturated cells to all neigbor cells. Not just the
     cell below.

    use h old : boolean (see section 4.1.2)

       h lim: number [cm]
        Parameter
